name: vendor-skills
description: The vendoring tool for Agent Skills: install SKILL.md skills from any git remote at a pinned commit, behind a validation gate, into .agents/skills/ with a committed lockfile - reproducible, offline-friendly, zero telemetry.

scripts.demo: node dist/src/cli.js init demo-skill && node dist/src/cli.js validate && node dist/src/cli.js list
